title: A service-named process starts a shell (service started after the loader)
threat_model: An attacker who controls a network service makes it run a shell command, so the shell is a direct child of a process that carries the service's name. The service process was started after the monitoring began.
notes: The service is a copy of bash named nginx in the scenario work directory, run by the action, which makes it start /bin/sh -c with the marker. The shell is a direct child, so unusual_ancestry leaves it to shell_from_service and cannot alert on it, and no other rule applies to this activity, so no alert is listed as acceptable.
